title: Skyrim: The Abridged Edition
tagline: Skyrim, but it's a silly place.
description:
I set out to make a set of modified set of prompts for SkyrimNet that would turn my Skyrim installation into a hilarious self-parody. By that standard, I have failed. What I ended up with instead was a slightly snarkier version of Skyrim where everyone is a little bit more ridiculous, but still takes things somewhat seriously. It's not what I set out to make, but there are occasionally some genuinely hilarious moments.

I asked if anyone was interested and at least one person said yes, so here it is. I probably won't do much more with this, but if anyone has suggestions for ways to improve the prompts to achieve the level of silliness that I was originally going for, I'm open to trying it out.
author: pdusen
